title: AADSTS and Microsoft Graph error codes: attack signal, MITRE technique and category, with the lab that produced them
description: Open dataset classifying Microsoft Entra ID AADSTS sign-in error codes for security triage: kind (failure, interrupt, config), attack-signal rating, related MITRE ATT&CK techniques, sign-in log tables and related codes. Version 1.2.0 has 98 AADSTS codes, 43 of them missing from Microsoft's error code reference (field inMicrosoftReference), and marks which were reproduced in a lab tenant (34), which have a captured sign-in log row (16) and which had the page's KQL run against those rows (11). New in 1.2.0: a second dataset of 8 named Microsoft Graph error codes, each with the exact message the live service returned, which exists because Microsoft publishes no current reference for them - its Graph error page lists HTTP statuses and names no codes, and most named codes survive only on a retired 2016 Azure AD Graph page. Also new: lab/ contains the reproduction scripts, the GitHub Actions workflows that run them and the raw output of every run, so the lab-reproduced rows can be checked or re-run rather than taken on trust. Full explanations and KQL at https://brambrinkmeier.com/entra/aadsts/ and https://brambrinkmeier.com/entra/graph/
